points.identity_evidence: Westernmost tip of the largest interior Middle Pond island, east-west two-lobed form with small island to its east and southwest. Entire two-segment closed modern coast-river-island shoreline checked. Pond entrances and barrier geometry are not this control.
points.rejection_reason: Large island locality plausible, but the two historical southwest islands are absent in modern context, the shore orientation/proportions differ, and nearby banks have changed. Exact historical-to-modern island correspondence remains uncertain; original off-shore pixel is preserved, not promoted.
